verdict.rationale: EFTPS documents that sign-in uses credential MFA through the third-party providers Login.gov and ID.me, which is required as of October 19, 2023, and an authorized human can complete that remotely. However, the published enrollment path ends with a PIN sent by U.S. Mail in five to seven business days, which is exactly the physical-mail gate the story excludes. Missing for 10: a fully remote first-time access path with no mailed PIN, and documentation of whether the Login.gov/ID.me flow avoids biometric liveness or in-person verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail

citations.quote: Secure sign-in via Login.gov or ID.me is required as of October 19, 2023.
EFTPS is partnering with third-party credential service providers Login.gov and ID.me for MFA services.
